prompt:
Extract a SysML v2 model from the document as a list of facts. Each fact has unit_id (the sentence it comes from), type and slots. Give only the slots that have a value, as a list of {slot, value} pairs; for composition give one 'parts' pair per part.

Types and slots:
  attribute(owner,name,value,unit) action(performer,label) state(owner,label) constraint(subject,expression) requirement(subject,text)
  composition(whole,parts) flow(source,target,payload) succession(before,after) transition(from,to,trigger) allocation(action,to)

Name each element by its full name as first introduced in the document.
RULES:
- Resolve every entity-valued slot using all the text you are given. If a sentence refers to an element by an alias, abbreviation, pronoun or shorter description, write the element's full name as first introduced. If a sentence says an element receives or uses an item and the text you are given states which element produces or sends that item, emit a flow from that producer to the receiver. If an element cannot be determined from the text you are given, use null; never guess.
- Never write placeholder words such as "any", "all", "some state" for an unstated element; use null.
- Do not merge differently named things unless the text says they are the same.
- Emit one action for EVERY behavior verb phrase, including passive voice (performer null), capability statements, displays, logs, generates and reports. label = the verbatim verb phrase with its object.
- Emit a requirement for every NORMATIVE statement (shall, must, should, will, is required to, needs to). Purpose, goal or benefit sentences are not requirements.
- Emit a state for every named mode or state; transitions use the state names, with from null when the prior state is not stated.
- Emit a succession only for an EXPLICIT temporal connective between two actions ("then", "after", "once", "before", "when ... is complete", "next", "finally"); before/after are the action labels. Never use succession for cause or data transfer.
- Resolve a pronoun or "this/these" performer to the element named in the preceding sentence and write that element's name; if it cannot be resolved, use null. Never output a pronoun as a slot value.
- Drop determiners and quantifiers from element names ("Each Soil Moisture Probe" -> "Soil Moisture Probe", "the system" -> "system").
- allocation.to must be a component or actor, never a mode or state.
- Emit a constraint for every threshold, limit, period or deadline stated with a number; expression = the verbatim phrase.
- Emit a flow for every sentence in which an element sends, transmits, reports, displays, commands or delivers an item (target null if the receiver is not named).
 Also list under "entities" every system element, actor or item named in the document units, with its full name and any alias the text explicitly declares for it (e.g. 'hereafter X', 'known as X', 'called X'); aliases [] if none. Return JSON {"entities": [...], "facts": [...]}.

Memory from EARLIER parts of the document (do not extract facts from it; use it only to resolve names, aliases and who produces an item):
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System supports detection/suppression; incident command retains authority. No autonomous dispatch, independent command decisions, or direct equipment/personnel control. Participants: local fire agencies, county emergency management, state wildland fire resources, aviation support units, cooperating public safety partners.

Caldera Incident Command Portal (Emberhall), primary interface for Duty Detection Officer (Orion), County Emergency Liaison, and command staff, displays camera views, detection history, weather context, maps, recommendations, and status transitions. Crewline Mobile Tablet provides approved operational information remotely.

North Lookout Camera Mast and South Lookout Camera Mast provide overlapping viewsheds, hardened infrastructure, licensed wireless video backhaul, and cellular degraded-mode connectivity where available. North Lookout Camera Mast sends Thermal Spot Snippet upon locally identifying candidate heat.

Horizon Ridge Drone Dock (Kestrel), on an accessible graded pad near central ridge road, supports launch/recovery/charging/shelter; includes weather-rated enclosures, charging interfaces, health monitoring, secure network termination. Its maintenance controller produces Battery Swap Ticket at configured battery replacement threshold. Drone Tasking Service manages approved flight requests, constraints, and status—not flight-release authority. Drone Pilot Operator reviews routes/dock/constraints before procedural coordination.

Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine (Lantern) aggregates detections/weather/geospatial context/operator feedback into traceable advisory recommendations. Smoke Classifier Module supplies plume-confidence scores. Analytics retain event timing, source identifiers, model versions, operator acknowledgments.

MesoWest Weather Fusion Node (Brindle) ingests stations/forecasts/quality checks; sends Wind Shift Bulletin on configured significant-wind-change rules. VHF Radio Gateway Repeater bridges selected radio traffic/workstations with policy-aligned monitoring, recording, access controls.

County Emergency Liaison coordinates warnings/roads/shelters. Orion reviews/verifies/escalates; Confirmed Ignition State requires supporting observations/procedures and authorized acceptance/rejection/further verification. Airspace Restricted State supports compliant aviation/drone coordination. Air Attack Supervisor advises tactics. Tanker Base Manager uses mission/loading status associated with Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console, East Retardant Loading Pump, West Retardant Loading Pump. Helitack Crew Leader and Drone Pilot Operator share conditions/timing/hazards. Suppression support covers priorities/resources/movement/aviation/safety pauses/fire-behavior assessment.

Document units:
S047: Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console supports the Air Attack Supervisor and Tanker Base Manager by presenting aircraft coordination data, loading status, and mission notes relevant to suppression support.
S048: East Retardant Loading Pump and West Retardant Loading Pump are represented in the site layout as monitored ground assets whose readiness and fault indications are visible to authorized operations staff.
S049: Crewline Mobile Tablet provides the Helitack Crew Leader with field access to assigned incident context, map references, and updates that have been approved for mobile distribution.
S050: Across the site, network segmentation, time synchronization, equipment health checks, and audit logging are treated as baseline infrastructure rather than optional add-ons.
S051: The detection workflow begins when the North Lookout Camera Mast, South Lookout Camera Mast, or Horizon Ridge Drone Dock provides an observation that may indicate a new ignition.
S052: Each observation is time stamped, georeferenced, and associated with equipment status before it is evaluated as operational evidence.
S053: The Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine receives the observation context and normalizes image, thermal, and weather attributes into a common event record.
S054: Smoke indications are initially assessed for plume texture, persistence, motion, and contrast against the background terrain.
S055: Thermal cues are treated as supporting evidence unless they persist across sequential frames or align with a visible smoke indication.
S056: The Smoke Classifier Module produces the Ridge Shadow Mask when terrain-shadow conditions could otherwise inflate a smoke confidence score.
S057: The analytics score is not considered a declaration of fire, because atmospheric glare, dust, vehicle exhaust, and cloud shadow can produce similar signatures.
S058: MesoWest Weather Fusion Node provides local wind, humidity, temperature, and stability context that helps determine whether an indication is plausible for active combustion.
S059: When the automated confidence level exceeds the screening threshold, the Caldera Incident Command Portal opens a triage case for human review.
S060: The Duty Detection Officer reviews the triage case, compares current imagery with recent frames, and checks whether the indication is growing, drifting, or disappearing.
S061: The Duty Detection Officer may request a fresh pan, tilt, or zoom view from the nearest fixed camera when the initial frame is ambiguous.
S062: If terrain, smoke column height, or occlusion prevents a clear fixed-camera view, the Drone Tasking Service may prepare a verification task for the Horizon Ridge Drone Dock.
